items.event: DP World Tour Championship, Dubai (final round)
items.line: Joost Luiten (-5), the last player into the 50-man field, leads after R1. McIlroy is two back in T3 after a 69 and needs a top-4 finish to pass Race to Dubai leader Eugenio Chacarra (72). A win would guarantee him a record-tying eighth Race to Dubai title.
items.whenJst: Sun Nov 15 · leaders tee off ~17:30 JST, finish ~22:00 JST (approx.)
